IS 17150 : 2025 Mini Domestic Water Heater for Use with Piped Natural Gas (PNG) - Specification
ICS 75.160.30; 97.040.20
ICS 75.160.30; 97.040.20
MED 23
MED 23
Revised Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard covers the requirements for instantaneous domestic water heater of nominal useful heat output less than 25 kW (based on gross calorific value), for use with Piped Natural Gases (PNG) at a working pressure of 21 mbar (21.41 gf/cm2). It is an inlet water controlled appliance. It specifies the main constructional and performance characteristics for the instantaneous domestic water heater. It also sets the appropriate test methods for evaluating test characteristics. Appliances for boiling water are not covered in this standard.
NOTE - CNG filed cylinder or PNG may be used for performance test and tests according to 4.1.9 and 4.1.11.
1.1.1 For convenience, this standard has been divided into three sections as follows:
a) Section 1 - Construction;
b) Section 2 - Performance requirements; and
c) Section 3 - General.
